name: caption
title: Word-timed caption
description: Captions that show a few words at a time (a chunk never crosses a sentence break or a pause of 0.35 s or more). A chunk swaps on at its first word and off when the next one starts (a cut); next to a pause it gets a short entrance or exit on a designed curve (in AND out, never a fade-up preset); only the words named in `stress` take the accent colour, and karaoke on every word is optional (off by default). Works for Hebrew (RTL set on the text, never on the root) and English.
